jobs.title: Physics Tutor in Tulsa
jobs.description:
BuffTutor is a network of experienced and passionate tutors who provide academic assistance to college & high school students. We are always hiring dedicated tutors; if you love teaching, join us!
RESPONSIBILITIES:

•
Provide 1-on-1 in-person tutoring to students attending universities or high schools in Tulsa such as University of Tulsa.

•
Provide online tutoring to students located throughout the country (if desired).

•
Assist students with Physics topics

• Classical mechanics: Kinematics, dynamics, forces, momentum, energy
,• Thermodynamics: Heat, temperature, ideal gases, laws of thermodynamics
,• Electricity and magnetism: Charges, fields, potential, circuits, induction
,• Waves and optics: Wave characteristics, sound, geometric/physical optics
,• Relativity and modern physics: Time dilation, length contraction, quantum basics
,• Nuclear physics: Radioactivity, fission, fusion, and atomic structures

BENEFITS:
• Set your own rate.
• In-person & online tutoring available; meet wherever works for you.
• Set your own schedule; meet whenever works for you.
• Work with as many (or as few) students as you would like to.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Have at least a 3.0 or better major GPA (out of 4.0).
• Have earned a B or better in the courses you wish to tutor.
• Have at least one year (or two semesters) of experience as a tutor, teacher, teaching/learning assistant or instructor.
• Have excellent communication skills and you must be fluent in the language that you teach in. Foreign Language tutors must be fluent in the Foreign Language they wish to tutor.

ABOUT BUFFTUTOR:
BuffTutor is dedicated to connecting students with intelligent and experienced tutors. We primarily focus on university level tutoring, but also work with high school and middle school students. More than just another tutor list, we prioritize the academic needs of our students while also treating our tutors with dignity and respect:
• We have some of the strictest eligibility criteria and challenging proficiency exams. Only the best can join our network!
• Tutors can set their own schedule. Our motto is quality is more important than quantity. Take on one student but be the best tutor for that student!
• Tutors can set their own rate. Earn what you are worth!
• We review student evaluations to help us keep the best tutor in our network.
BuffTutor was founded in 2009 and since then we have helped thousands of students and parents connect with affordable and passionate educators!
Please note that tutors are independent contractors, not employees. All applicants must already have work permissions; applicants who are students must be able to work an off-campus position. We do not sponsor individuals and we cannot work with F-1 or J-1 international students

This position performs skilled, technical work installing, operating, maintaining, and repairing electrical, instrumentation, control, and communication systems used in City of Wichita wastewater treatment plants, lift stations, force mains, and reuse facilities. Employees troubleshoot complex electrical and control issues, service PLC and SCADA components, calibrate meters and instruments, and support safe, reliable operation of critical wastewater infrastructure. Employees within the department or division shall be given first consideration

Posting may close at any time

• Knowledge in the use of electrical testing devices.

• Knowledge of the standard computer keyboard configurations and ability to access, interpret, and record information using a video display terminal and electronic keyboard
• Ability to read and interpret drawings, blueprints, and specifications

jobs.title: Junior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
A top client of ours out of the Midwest is looking to add a Junior Data Analyst / SQL Developer to their team to support database operations, data validation, and onboarding processes within a healthcare data environment. This role is ideal for an early-career professional with a foundational understanding of relational databases, SQL scripting, and data analysis who is eager to develop their technical skills.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with Oracle or PostgreSQL databases, understanding data relationships, and troubleshooting data integrity issues. This individual will play an important role in reviewing SQL scripts, validating data onboarding activities, and ensuring accuracy and consistency across interconnected database systems.

This role is contract and remote, not open to C2C.

Key Responsibilities
• Review, analyze, and validate SQL scripts and database processes to ensure accurate data onboarding and integration.
• Execute testing procedures to verify that data onboarding activities have been completed correctly and meet established requirements.
• Identify data discrepancies, errors, or inconsistencies and collaborate with onboarding teams to resolve issues.
• Investigate complex data relationships, including identifying why records may be incorrectly linked or associated across systems.
• Write and execute SQL queries to retrieve, analyze, validate, and troubleshoot data across multiple database tables and systems.
• Review existing stored procedures, SQL scripts, and database logic to understand functionality and identify potential issues.
• Develop an understanding of relational database structures, primary and foreign keys, table relationships, and data dependencies.
• Support data integrity investigations and assist with developing SQL-based solutions to correct or reconcile data issues.
• Learn and become proficient in established database tables, data structures, and internal processes.
• Follow documented procedures and standardized playbooks to support consistent and repeatable data validation activities.
• Collaborate with technical teams to troubleshoot database issues and improve data quality and operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications
• 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, database development, database administration, or a related technical role.
• Hands-on experience writing and executing SQL queries, preferably using Oracle SQL or PostgreSQL.
• Foundational understanding of relational database management systems (RDBMS), including database structures and relationships.
• Knowledge of primary keys, foreign keys, joins, and how data is connected across multiple tables.
• Ability to query, retrieve, and analyze data from multiple tables or database systems.
• Experience reviewing SQL scripts, troubleshooting queries, and identifying data inconsistencies.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate data relationships and identify root causes.
• High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional technical teams.
• Willingness to learn new database environments, business processes, and established technical procedures.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical / Instrumentation Engineer (Senior E/I Engineer)
jobs.description:
Position Overview

TRC is a pioneer in engineering innovation, delivering breakthrough solutions across commercial, industrial, and government projects. In this senior-level role, a seasoned Electrical and Instrumentation Engineer will determine client requirements and develop comprehensive E/I design solutions for natural gas pipeline facilities, petroleum liquids pumping stations, and related infrastructure. The position demands the ability to originate designs, supervise engineering teams, and employ specialized software tools like ETAP, SKM, and Easy Power to ensure robust, cost-effective outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Familiarity with applicable codes such as NFPA 70, 70E, 497, AGA 3, 9, XF0277, API RP 500, NEMA MG 1-2006, ICS 7.1-2006, etc.

• Evaluate client requirements and develop design basis and scope for E/I work.

• Conduct cost-benefit analyses for competing E/I solutions to achieve robust, cost-effective designs.

• Provide hands-on electrical/instrumentation engineering support while mentoring less experienced engineers.

• Prepare various station studies and engineering calculations including load studies, short-circuit analysis, relay coordination, arc flash studies, motor starting dynamics, harmonics, ground fault, and other related calculations.

• Contribute to refining departmental procedures and company specifications as part of the Senior E/I leadership team.

• Utilize specialized software (ETAP, SKM, Easy Power) for electrical system modeling and scenario studies.

• Prepare material requisitions including equipment specifications and instrumentation data sheets.

• Assist in the development of client proposals and project cost estimates.

• Design power generating systems for standby, peak shaving, and co-generation; and develop medium/low voltage distribution systems including substation, service, switchgear, relay protection, MCCs, VFDs, motor starters, lighting, grounding, and hazardous area wiring methods.

• Design instrumentation systems for facility and pipeline measurement and control, including field instruments, control valves, pressure safety devices, station/unit control, emergency systems, and alarm/security systems.

Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an accredited college or university.

• Experience Required: Minimum 10 years of experience in electrical and instrumentation engineering.

• Licensing: Professional Engineer (PE) licensing is desired.

• Language Skills: Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

• Mathematical Skills: Proficiency in the engineering mathematics required for a Bachelor’s degree in engineering.

• Reasoning Ability: Proven ability to identify problems, develop solutions, and make decisions that drive overall project success.

• Other Skills and Abilities: Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, ability to supervise subordinate engineers and CADD personnel, flexibility with working hours, and willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Benefits & Perks

• Compensation: In accordance with local law, the salary range for this position is determined based on experience, education, skill level, geographical location, and other compensable factors.

• Salary: USD $130,021.00 - USD $145,080.00 per year.

• Other Compensation: Eligibility for participation in the Company’s annual Discretionary Bonus Program based on performance.

• Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.

• 401k package with both traditional and Roth IRA options, including Company match.

• Paid time off ranging from 15 to 25 days per year and a minimum of 8 paid holidays annually.

• Paid sick, family, and disability leave in accordance with applicable laws.

jobs.title: Copy of Instrumentation and Controls Inspector - Contract
jobs.description:
We are SGS – the world’s leading testing, inspection and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. Our 98,000 employees operate a network of 2,650 offices and laboratories, working together to enable a better, safer and more interconnected world.

Job Description

The Instrumentation and Controls Inspector (Contract) will perform vendor shop inspections to verify that instrumentation, control systems, and associated equipment comply with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes and standards, and purchase order requirements.

Location: Vendor shops across the United States

Pay rate: $48–$55 per hour

Contract: 1099 subcontractor agreement

Schedule: Intermittent assignments, when and where required, subject to job requirements

Start date: January 2027 and ongoing

Travel expenses: Expenses covered at cost when the inspection site is beyond a 200-mile round trip from the inspector’s residence and requires an overnight hotel stay.

Responsibilities:

• Verify vendor-manufactured or supplied instrumentation, control systems, and associated equipment against approved drawings, project specifications, applicable codes and standards, and purchase order requirements.
• Perform hands-on vendor inspections of transmitters, control valves, analyzers, PLC/DCS panels, and instrumentation packages.
• Review approved Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), technical specifications, datasheets, drawings, quality documentation, and manufacturing procedures.
• Witness Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) of programmable logic controller (PLC), distributed control system (DCS), and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, control panels, instrument cabinets, and associated control systems. Verify instrument calibration, functional testing, and performance testing.
• Inspect electrical and electronic components, wiring, terminations, grounding, and enclosure protection, including NEMA/IP ratings.
• Inspect pressure, temperature, flow, and level transmitters, gauges, switches, control valves, actuators, and positioners.
• Witness point-to-point continuity tests, loop checks, input/output (I/O) testing, instrument calibration against certified reference standards, and alarm, interlock, trip, and shutdown function testing.
• Verify PLC/DCS logic, communication interfaces, and system integration testing, as applicable.
• Review FAT procedures, test results, and punch-list items. Verify compliance with approved FAT acceptance criteria before final acceptance.

Qualifications

• Journeyman or Master Electrician qualification.
• Degree in Instrumentation / Electrical Engineering or an Engineering Technology diploma.
• Minimum 5 years of experience in electrical QA/QC and manufacturing / construction inspection.
• Working knowledge of NFPA, UL, NEMA, OSHA, and relevant IEC/IEEE standards as specified by the project.
• Experience inspecting instrumentation, control valves, PLC/DCS systems, control panels, and associated equipment.

Contract type: 1099 (sub-contractor agreement)
